# Tirrion Toronto

> Portfolio of Tirrion Toronto (also known as Lucas James), a cybersecurity student and IT problem solver in Arusha, Tanzania. Site: https://tirrion.pages.dev/

## About
- Cybersecurity, cryptography, Python security tools, IT support, networks and hardware troubleshooting, packaging and graphic design.
- Languages: Swahili and English.

## Projects
- SecuDrive: Windows antivirus built with Python and PyQt6 that recovers infected files without data loss.
- Land Marketplace and Property Verification System for Tanzania (web system).
